id.description: Must exactly equal the bundle file's filename stem (bundle files are named <id>.json). A mismatch is loaded as BundleIdMismatchError, not silently accepted -- scope resolution for bundle:<id> is exact only.

description.description: One or two sentences stating WHAT the feature is -- an expansion of `label`. Rationale for why artifacts were grouped this way belongs in an ADR, not here. There is no length cap: a truncated description is worse than a long one, because the reader cannot tell what was cut.

draft.description: True when this bundle is a generated proposal awaiting human acceptance.
